create_mesa_view: create a MesaView instance with a ViewConfig for headless OpenGL rendering
render_scene_with_mesa: render a Transform scene using MesaView with background image and shader support
initialize_mesa_context: initialize an OS Mesa context with RGBA buffer for offscreen rendering
prepare_shaders_for_rendering: prepare bvh, color, and texture shaders from GLSL source files for rendering
cleanup_mesa_context: cleanup and destroy the OS Mesa context when rendering is complete
